sql: SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS within_promise FROM caseflow.cases c JOIN caseflow.teams t ON t.team_id = c.team_id WHERE c.status IN ('approved', 'declined') AND c.working_days_open <= 3 AND c.decided_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND c.decided_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY t.team_name
explanation: Decisions in October 2026 made within 3 working days of receipt, by team.
assumptions: Within the promise means working_days_open of 3 or fewer
